The main takeaway from our work is that
the resistant tomato line, PI 114490, has a greater number of differentially expressed (DE) genes than the susceptible tomato line OH 881119.
the tomato line PI 14 490 has a much more vigorous defense response than the susceptible line OH88119, and that this defense is not triggered immediately but rather is delayed until about 6 DPI.
